playbooks.title: SaaS: find and repair the constraint to retained value
applies_when: Recurring software product with a defined useful customer outcome.

decision_branches.if: No observed problem or buying evidence
decision_branches.then: Run customer episode research before scaling traffic.

decision_branches.if: Qualified users arrive but cannot reach first value
decision_branches.then: Observe the task and remove one verified obstacle.

decision_branches.if: Activated customers leave before repeat value
decision_branches.then: Investigate product fit and recurring usefulness before paid expansion.

decision_branches.if: Retention, economics, and capacity support expansion
decision_branches.then: Test one eligible distribution mechanism with explicit downside.

steps: Define eligibility and exclude irrelevant signups from the decision population.
Reconcile acquisition, activation, payments, cancellations, and refunds at account grain.
Interview or observe recent eligible users around the last incomplete task; preserve dissenting cases.
Select an intervention that changes one plausible cause, not every funnel stage at once.
Estimate cohort contribution and support burden; reserve the experiment budget.
Launch only after concrete approval, track first value and downstream paid quality, and review after outcomes mature.

metrics.name: activation_rate
metrics.formula: eligible accounts reaching first value within window / eligible new accounts

metrics.name: observed_cohort_contribution
metrics.formula: cohort net revenue over fixed horizon - included cohort service costs

metrics.name: support_minutes_per_activated_account
metrics.formula: eligible support minutes / activated eligible accounts

stop_conditions: Broken account identity or payment reconciliation
Change makes task completion worse beyond declared guardrail
Budget or support capacity exhausted
Observation window incomplete: return pending, not a success claim
playbooks.hypothetical_application: Hypothetical: a team has qualified trials but no activation instrumentation. ClimbOS first specifies the event and observes setup. It does not invent a trial-to-paid projection or prescribe a broadcast to an audience that has not opted in.

playbooks.title: Mac apps: prove utility and match the distribution path
applies_when: Native macOS utility or application with verifiable compatibility and distribution method.
required_inputs: Useful task and time to first success

decision_branches.if: Install or first task fails
decision_branches.then: Fix reliability and compatibility before increasing discovery.

decision_branches.if: Traffic reaches listing but promise is misunderstood
decision_branches.then: Test asset comprehension with suitable users.

decision_branches.if: Native store experiment is not eligible for the actual platform
decision_branches.then: Choose a supported external test or qualitative method; label confounding.

decision_branches.if: Stable task success and sustainable economics
decision_branches.then: Test one relevant community, search, partner, or editorial route.

steps: Confirm actual supported platform, build, pricing, and capabilities before drafting claims.
Map the complete path from discovery to download, launch, first successful task, and retained use.
Review support and crash evidence by build and machine type where permission allows.
Prepare a benefit-led asset sequence using real product captures and accurate limitations.
Select only platform-supported experiment methods; preserve concurrent version changes.
Evaluate useful adoption, refunds, reliability, and support alongside installation counts.

metrics.name: first_task_success
metrics.formula: eligible installs completing the useful task / eligible measured installs

metrics.name: net_license_contribution
metrics.formula: net license revenue - defined payment, distribution, serving, and support costs

metrics.name: refund_rate
metrics.formula: refunded purchases / purchases in the same matured purchase cohort

stop_conditions: Unsupported store feature assumed available
Material crash or compatibility issue unresolved
Claim cannot be demonstrated in the current build
New build changes test assets or task behavior without recording contamination
playbooks.hypothetical_application: Hypothetical: a clipboard utility gains downloads but users cannot understand its permissions. The next intervention clarifies the permission-dependent task and tests task completion. It does not assume iOS product-page optimization is available to a Mac App Store product.

playbooks.title: Agencies: improve qualified demand without overselling delivery
applies_when: Project or retainer service with scarce expert labor and contractual scope.
required_inputs: Delivery hours and available start slots

decision_branches.if: Delivery slots are full
decision_branches.then: Prioritize fit, pricing, scheduling, or qualified referrals over lead volume.

decision_branches.if: Calls occur but buyers do not progress
decision_branches.then: Diagnose qualification, proof, offer, and buying-process uncertainty.

decision_branches.if: Few relevant opportunities exist
decision_branches.then: Test one narrow offer and reachable segment.

decision_branches.if: Projects sell but cash or margins are weak
decision_branches.then: Review scope, change control, deposits, and collection before expansion.

steps: Define a repeatable service outcome and the client obligations needed to deliver it.
Map lead-to-cash using buyer-observable progress rather than seller optimism.
Reconstruct a recent win and a recent loss; separate unsupported explanations.
Create one proof asset with verified role, scope, result, and permission.
Estimate delivery load and proposal effort under downside win-rate scenarios.
Approve a bounded prospecting or inbound experiment with a capacity-aware booking limit.

metrics.name: project_contribution
metrics.formula: net project revenue - defined incremental delivery and service costs

metrics.name: delivery_load
metrics.formula: committed delivery hours / available delivery hours over the same period

metrics.name: qualified_opportunity_progression
metrics.formula: eligible opportunities reaching buyer-verified next stage / eligible opportunities

stop_conditions: Committed delivery exceeds approved capacity
Project scope or commercial terms unclear
Evidence asset contains unverified customer results
Contact source or sending provider is ineligible
playbooks.hypothetical_application: Hypothetical: a design studio can start two projects next month but its campaign predicts six. ClimbOS limits bookings, offers later start dates transparently, or recommends capacity changes. It does not call six simultaneous wins an unconditional success.

playbooks.title: Ecommerce: optimize fulfilled contribution, not attributed order value
applies_when: Physical or digital commerce with product availability, fulfillment, and return obligations.
required_inputs: Media attribution and store revenue definitions

decision_branches.if: Inventory or fulfillment cannot support demand
decision_branches.then: Repair availability, lead times, or a truthful waitlist before promotion.

decision_branches.if: High conversion is offset by returns or discounts
decision_branches.then: Investigate product fit and net contribution.

decision_branches.if: Qualified visitors abandon the purchase task
decision_branches.then: Diagnose total price, delivery, trust, payment, and device-specific failure.

decision_branches.if: Economics survive downside and stock is ready
decision_branches.then: Test a bounded offer or acquisition route.

steps: Reconcile SKU availability, net revenue, discounts, tax treatment, refunds, and fulfillment.
Trace a representative order from discovery to delivery and return.
Choose a specific obstacle and ensure the test can be fulfilled honestly.
Model order contribution before and after acquisition, then model cash tied in stock.
Set guardrails for refunds, complaints, delivery delays, and stock-outs.
Review matured outcomes before treating gross sales or platform ROAS as business profit.

metrics.name: order_contribution_before_acquisition
metrics.formula: net order revenue - product, payment, packaging, fulfillment, and expected return costs included in policy

metrics.name: incremental_contribution
metrics.formula: estimated incremental contribution from treatment - incremental campaign cost

metrics.name: on_time_fulfillment
metrics.formula: eligible orders fulfilled within promised window / eligible fulfilled orders

stop_conditions: Stock mismatch or misleading delivery promise
Negative expected contribution outside approved learning loss
Checkout tracking cannot reconcile to orders
Return window has not matured: distinguish provisional from final
playbooks.hypothetical_application: Hypothetical: a store increases sales with a large discount while shipping and returns erase the margin. ClimbOS flags net contribution and tests value communication or bundle economics before repeating the promotion.

playbooks.title: Local services: turn suitable inquiries into completed appointments
applies_when: Appointment-based or service-area business with finite schedule and delivery geography.

decision_branches.if: Bookings are unavailable in target area or time
decision_branches.then: Fix schedule or targeting before buying more inquiries.

decision_branches.if: Inquiries arrive but response is late
decision_branches.then: Repair ownership and response workflow.

decision_branches.if: Bookings do not become completed services
decision_branches.then: Investigate fit, scheduling, reminders, deposits, and attendance barriers.

decision_branches.if: Reliable completion and economics exist
decision_branches.then: Test eligible local search, partnerships, or referrals.

steps: Verify services, geographic eligibility, contact details, and actual available slots.
Map inquiry, response, qualification, booking, attendance, completion, and payment.
Review a small set of lost inquiries with permission; distinguish no answer from poor fit.
Improve one friction point and create a human escalation path.
Prepare truthful service and locality assets without inventing locations or reviews.
Measure completed profitable appointments, response effort, and customer complaints.

metrics.name: inquiry_to_completion
metrics.formula: eligible inquiries resulting in completed service within window / eligible inquiries

metrics.name: response_time
metrics.formula: first useful response timestamp - eligible inquiry timestamp

metrics.name: contribution_per_slot
metrics.formula: net collected revenue minus included service costs / occupied eligible slots

stop_conditions: Service-area mismatch
No capacity within promised window
Regulated claim lacks appropriate evidence or review
Automated response cannot handle urgent or sensitive inquiry: escalate
playbooks.hypothetical_application: Hypothetical: a repair service receives many inquiries outside its travel area. ClimbOS fixes qualification and targeting rather than interpreting every rejected inquiry as a sales failure.

playbooks.title: Marketplaces: diagnose liquidity at the market-cell level
applies_when: Business connecting distinct supply and demand participants for a transaction.
required_inputs: Market cell: geography, category, time, or use case
Quality, cancellation, dispute, and trust signals

decision_branches.if: Demand cannot find suitable available supply
decision_branches.then: Improve supply coverage or narrow the market cell before demand expansion.

decision_branches.if: Supply is idle despite qualified demand
decision_branches.then: Investigate discovery, trust, pricing, and matching rules.

decision_branches.if: Transactions occur only with unsustainable subsidies
decision_branches.then: Model unsubsidized behavior and contribution.

decision_branches.if: Cross-side effects contaminate individual tests
decision_branches.then: Choose a suitable cluster, geography, or other defensible design.

steps: Define the smallest useful market cell and map both sides of the transaction.
Measure availability and match failure reasons without averaging incompatible cells.
Check participant quality and the operational burden of disputes or cancellation.
Choose a targeted intervention on the constrained side and model the effect on the other side.
Select measurement that addresses interference and participant spillovers.
Evaluate completed quality transactions, repeat use, net contribution, and trust guardrails before expansion.

metrics.name: qualified_match_rate
metrics.formula: eligible demand requests receiving a suitable available match / eligible demand requests

metrics.name: transaction_contribution
metrics.formula: net platform revenue - defined processing, servicing, subsidy, and risk costs

metrics.name: cell_liquidity
metrics.formula: report match rate and time to match by defined cell; do not substitute one universal score

stop_conditions: Supply quality or safety guardrail breached
Subsidy exceeds authorized loss budget
Individual randomization invalidated by substantial spillovers
Reported growth is only migration from another market cell
playbooks.hypothetical_application: Hypothetical: a services marketplace has strong citywide signups but poor evening availability in one neighborhood. ClimbOS narrows the cell and investigates supply coverage rather than recommending citywide demand ads.
